items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: And a fellow named George Hall was the piano player upstairs, who could play a mess of piano.

ctx.x: And the people from all the downtown shows used to come up there, upstairs at the Panama, to hear us sing. There was nothing decorative about that, either. It was just a plain place. And a fellow named George Hall was the piano player upstairs, who could play a mess of piano.
What hours would this be that you performed there?
